replies.body:
Hello Joltrexwitz,

This player has already been punished for using Anti-KB. However, it's possible that he may have been using both types of hacks at the same time, but was banned for only one of the reasons. We will use this evidence for the future in case SGswordguy decides to appeal. Thanks for the report!

-PokerFace
